rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for professionalism in general.

example.english: That company always shows professionalism toward its customers and replies exactly when it says it will.
example.traditional: 間公司對客人一向有專業精神，答應幾點覆就幾點覆。
example.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 deoi3 haak3 jan4 jat1 hoeng3 jau5 zyun1 jip6 zing1 san4 daap3 jing3 gei2 dim2 fuk1 zau6 gei2 dim2 fuk1

rows.note: Use this when professionalism specifically means ethical conduct, integrity, or fair dealing.

example.english: When handling clients’ assets, lawyers must uphold professionalism and ethical standards.
example.traditional: 律師處理客戶資產，必須恪守專業操守。
example.jyutping: leot6 si1 cyu2 lei5 haak3 wu6 zi1 caan2 bit1 seoi1 kok3 sau2 zyun1 jip6 cou1 sau2

rows.note: Use this when professionalism specifically means a serious, reliable, and competent work attitude.

example.english: Even when they are in a rush to finish work, they maintain professionalism and explain everything clearly.
example.traditional: 就算趕住收工，佢都保持專業態度，逐樣嘢交代清楚。
